purpose: Requirements for ToC management: information managed per document, section and reference, AI-generated field limits, content hashing, change detection, and the build and finalization of the ToC.
summary: Information requirements for document info, section entries and reference entries in the ToC
Limits for AI-generated fields: description limit L and internal tolerance limit H = floor(L x 1.3), H hidden from the generating AI
ToC metadata storing the key and the normalized Index target specification, with change detection of the specification
Change detection against the existing ToC: new, body change, reference change, move or rename, departure, unchanged
Content hash as SHA-256 of original text, excluding reference link definition lines; 12-digit prefix recorded in link titles
Timing of updating reflected hashes together with ToC finalization
ToC build and rebuild in three stages, with atomic finalization and no publication of partial state
Information acquisition and update planning that avoids re-analyzing unchanged documents by AI
Reference relationship reconstruction and check states based on directory search
Build result output with counts on stdout and full details in a work file, plus acceptance conditions
tasks: Designing or implementing ToC build and rebuild
Implementing change detection and the change set
Implementing content hash and section hash calculation
Implementing validation of AI-generated field limits
Designing the ToC data model and stored metadata
Implementing ToC candidate verification and atomic finalization
Designing the build result report and detail file
Writing tests for ToC acceptance conditions
Generating document info with AI under description limits
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — [ToC]管理
